summary: Banco Santander (Brasil) filed a 6-K disclosing receipt of an improved exchange-offer communication from parent Banco Santander, S.A. The Offeror raised its previously announced exchange ratio by 5%: 0.4260 new Banco Santander shares per Santander Brasil unit or ADS (from 0.4056) and 0.2130 per common or preferred share (from 0.2028), adjusted to 0.4246/0.2124/0.2122 for dividends paid since July 30. Shares delivered as BDRs in Brazil or ADSs in New York. Banco Santander will seek capital-increase approval at an EGM expected December 15, 2026. Watch tender acceptance, EGM approval and ratio adjustments for dividends or buybacks.
